To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the droplet drift from a spinning disc CDA is affected by wind velocity and direction, the operator’s position relative to the target and the direction of wind, and the distance between the operator and the target.
the droplet size distribution and the drift of spray droplet from a hand-held ULV spinning-disc controlled droplets applicator (CDAQ) were determined.

the drift of spray droplet from a spinning-disc controlled droplets applicator (CDDA) was influenced by the direction of wind and the direction of walking of the operator, with the lowest drift occurring at 15–30° and the highest at 40–45o.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the drift of spray droplet from ULV spinning disc applicator.
the development of new methods of application of pesticides to control pests of agricultural importance.
the study of the drift of spray droplet from a ULV spinning-disc CDA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need for a more comprehensive and detailed study of the safety aspects of the use of ULVs in the field.
the drift of droplets from ULV spinning disc CDA is very low and is unlikely to pose any hazard.

the use of a hand held ULV sprayer by a trained and experienced operator is safe, provided that the operator is wearing protective clothing and that he/she does not spray in the direction of the prevailing wind.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the absence of a windbreak, a ULV sprayer should not be used when the wind direction is at an angle of 15°–20° to the direction of walking.
ULV sprayers should not be used in a wind direction of more than 45° from the direction of spraying.
, the use of ULVs is not a simple matter and that there are a number of factors to be taken into account.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ULV sprayers are a viable option for pest control in the home, but they must be used correctly and safely.
the spray drift of ULV spinning disc applicator is minimal and the operator is not exposed to the spray droplets when the operator is walking in the field.
the drift of spray droplet from ULV spinning-disc CDA can be reduced by spraying with the wind blowing from behind.
